subject: Insurance
title: Hurricane Andrew: The Wake-Up Call
description: A fast breakdown of Hurricane Andrew: The Wake-Up Call for builders.

hook.text: Hurricane Andrew hit Florida in 1992 and destroyed 63,000 homes. Insured losses: $27 billion.

buildup.text: Miami-Dade was leveled. Entire neighborhoods flattened.

discovery.text: Andrew forced insurers to adopt catastrophe modeling.

twist.text: Florida created Citizens Property Insurance—a state-backed insurer of last resort.

climax.text: Andrew transformed how the world prices natural disasters.

punchline.text: 11 insurers bankrupt. Andrew forced the industry to use catastrophe models.

quiz.question: What major change did Hurricane Andrew force on insurers?
